We are looking for an experienced technology recruitment leader to lead our existing team of recruiters globally.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining team management with active recruitment delivery. You will set priorities, develop the team and partner with technology leaders on their hiring needs, while personally managing a portfolio of technology vacancies.

The ideal candidate will have led technology recruitment teams within regulated financial services, preferably fintech, and will bring strong stakeholder management skills alongside a proven ability to deliver specialist technology hires.
q: 10+ years experience in both agency & inhouse roles.
A proven track record of leading technology recruitment teams within regulated financial services organisations.
Strong hands-on experience recruiting technology professionals across a range of disciplines and seniority levels.
Demonstrated ability to combine people management with personal recruitment delivery.
Experience managing geographically distributed teams and working with stakeholders across regions.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to advise and constructively challenge senior hiring managers.
A structured, data-informed approach to recruitment planning and delivery.
Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Technology recruitment leadership experience within fintech or crypto.
r: Lead, coach and develop a globally distributed team of technology recruiters.
Partner with technology leaders to understand hiring requirements and translate them into clear recruitment priorities.
Personally manage end-to-end recruitment for technology roles, from role briefing and sourcing through assessment, offer and close.
Balance team leadership with hands-on delivery, allocating workloads and adapting priorities as business needs change.
Build talent pipelines for specialist and difficult-to-fill technology positions.
Strengthen recruitment practices, including sourcing strategies, interview processes and candidate assessment.
Use recruitment data to monitor delivery, identify bottlenecks and improve hiring outcomes.
Ensure a consistent, professional candidate experience and recruitment practices aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

d: We are looking for ambitious fresh graduates and final-year students to join our 2-month structured Internship Program in Bahrain!
This program is designed to give you hands-on experience inside a fast-paced global organization through real projects, active mentorship, and cross-functional exposure across our regional ecosystem.
People Operations (Tech/HR) - People Operations bridges high-growth talent acquisition with organizational scale, treating employees as internal customers to optimize both productivity and culture.

Marketing (Brand, CEM & Campaigns) - full-funnel acquisition, customer retention, and brand resonance by bridging creative brand activations with rigorous campaign analytics. The team creates targeted promotional campaigns, runs localized field activations, and continuously monitors Customer Experience Management (CEM) metrics to reduce churn.

tMart / Q-Commerce (Commercial) - The Commercial division of the quick-commerce grocery business focuses on gross merchandise value (GMV), product margins, and stock availability across darkstores. They negotiate key vendor terms, manage dynamic pricing, and build localized product assortments tailored to neighborhoods served by micro-fulfillment centers. Their ultimate objective is to maximize basket size and inventory turnover while minimizing write-offs and out-of-stock rates on high-velocity SKUs.

Sales (Operations & Account Management) - drives revenue by acquiring, onboarding, and scaling partnerships with merchants and B2B vendors. The team transitions partners from cold outreach to active onboarding, managing day-to-day account operations to maximize partner sales performance on the platform. By utilizing field sales tracking and structured account-management reviews, Sales protects merchant retention and unlocks upselling opportunities that increase platform revenue.
IT & Infrastructure (Darkstore Networking) - IT Infrastructure builds and maintains the foundational network stack required to run high-speed micro-fulfillment centers with zero downtime. .

Logistics (Vendor to Last-Mile Operations) - Logistics governs the physical movement of orders from vendor handover all the way through live dispatch and last-mile delivery. The division optimizes rider fleet allocation, refines dispatch algorithms, and enforces strict operational SLA thresholds to guarantee rapid delivery windows.
Own Real Deliverables: Work on live, impactful projects within your chosen function rather than side tasks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner alongside experienced professionals locally and connect with regional teams across the MENA region.
Day-to-Day Execution: Gain practical exposure to how a tech-driven, fast-growing multinational operates.
Continuous Growth: Participate in feedback loops and mentorship sessions to accelerate your professional development.
q: Recent graduate or final-year student with a Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to your chosen functional track.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a strong eagerness to learn.
Proactive, detail-oriented, and ready to take ownership of tasks.
Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; Arabic is a plus.

Bybit is looking for a Head of Social Media who is equal parts creative visionary and operational leader. This is not a "post and pray" role — you will own the global social strategy for one of the world's top crypto exchanges, lead a distributed team across regions, and be the connective tissue between brand, product, community, and culture.

You will inherit a team that is growing fast, working with external agencies, and navigating the complexity of a global rebrand (Brand 6.0). You'll need to bring structure without killing creativity, and bring creativity without losing accountability.
q: 4–8 years of social media experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership role managing a team
Marketing background — you think in campaigns, narratives, and audience journeys, not just posts
Proven track record of growing social accounts at scale for a global brand (1M+ followers preferred)
Strong project management skills — you can run multiple workstreams, manage agencies, and hit deadlines without chaos
Experience with Sprinklr or equivalent enterprise social media management platforms
AI-native mindset — you actively use AI tools in your workflow for content, research, and analysis
Exceptional written and spoken English; additional languages (Arabic, Mandarin, Spanish, Portuguese) are a strong plus
Experience managing influencer programs end-to-end, including legal and compliance workflows
Background working with executive communications — writing for or managing the social presence of C-suite spokespeople
Experience with rebranding or brand evolution at a global company
Familiarity with OAP/project management systems and cross-functional campaign coordination
Deep knowledge of crypto, Web3, or fintech — you can write about DeFi, trading products, and market events without needing a translator (optional)
You'll be shaping the social voice of a top-3 global crypto exchange during a pivotal rebranding moment
Direct access to and collaboration with the executive leadership
A team that is genuinely invested in getting better — we're building SOPs, improving briefs, and upgrading our tooling (new OAP system launching mid-August)
Real budget, real agencies, real campaigns — this is not a one-person show
A culture that values ownership, speed, and creative courage
Someone who needs to be told what to post
Someone who can't write a content brief or manage an agency
Someone who treats social as a support function rather than a growth engine
Someone who can't handle ambiguity or a fast-moving environment
r: Define and execute Bybit's global social media strategy across X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging platforms
Translate complex crypto and fintech concepts into compelling, platform-native content that resonates with traders, retail users, and the broader Web3 community
Build and maintain Bybit's social voice — bold, credible, and culturally relevant — in alignment with Brand 6.0 guidelines
Develop channel/product-specific strategies that balance global consistency with regional relevance
Lead, mentor, and grow a global social media team (currently ~4–6 members) plus manage relationships with production and influencer agencies and other departments
Establish clear workflows, content brief processes, and approval protocols to eliminate last-minute requests and ensure quality at scale
Build and own the content calendar, ensuring alignment with campaigns, product launches, market moments, and executive communications
Implement SOPs for content creation, agency briefing, influencer collaboration, and crisis response
Partner with the Creative team on campaign assets, ensuring briefs are detailed, timely, and actionable
Oversee influencer strategy — from shortlisting and legal clearance to performance tracking
Manage the production agency relationship for high-quality video content the internal team cannot produce at speed
Own social media OKRs: follower growth, organic engagement, share of voice, sentiment, and new user acquisition via social
Use Sprinklr and native platform analytics to run weekly performance reviews and quarterly post-mortems
Present social performance to leadership in biweekly reviews; flag risks and opportunities proactively
Leverage AI tools for trend harvesting, content optimization, and competitive analysis
Work closely with BU marketing teams (WBU, GBU, PBU) to support product-specific social moments without duplicating effort
Align with the Strategy Office on global go-to-market strategy and upper-funnel performance
Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on influencer clearances, regulatory messaging, and market-specific restrictions
